verdict.rationale: DeepInfra states a zero-retention policy claiming inputs/outputs are not stored, with SOC2/ISO27001 certification (deepinfra-docs-23), which implies privacy-friendly handling but there is no documented user-facing control panel, API, or explicit deletion mechanism letting users manage or delete stored data themselves. missing for 10: explicit data retention settings/dashboard, user-initiated deletion API or request process, retention duration options, independent verification of the zero-retention claim.
